+    import random
+    import time
+    
+    # Initial layout: randomized points to explore space
+    pts = [[random.random(), random.random()] for _ in range(n)]
+    
+    def get_min_area(points):
+        m_area = 1e18
+        for i in range(n):
+            for j in range(i + 1, n):
+                for k in range(j + 1, n):
+                    # 0.5 * |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)|
+                    a = points[i][0] * (points[j][1] - points[k][1]) + \
+                        points[j][0] * (points[k][1] - points[i][1]) + \
+                        points[k][0] * (points[i][1] - points[j][1])
+                    area = 0.5 * abs(a)
+                    if area < m_area:
+                        m_area = area
+        return m_area
+
+    # Optimization loop
+    best_area = get_min_area(pts)
+    best_pts = [p[:] for p in pts]
+    
+    start_t = time.time()
+    # Step size for moves
+    step = 0.2
+    # Decay factor for step size
+    decay = 0.99999
+    
+    while time.time() - start_t < 58:
+        # Select a random point to move
+        idx = random.randint(0, n - 1)
+        old_x, old_y = pts[idx]
+        
+        # Propose move
+        pts[idx][0] = max(0.0, min(1.0, old_x + random.uniform(-step, step)))
+        pts[idx][1] = max(0.0, min(1.0, old_y + random.uniform(-step, step)))
+        
+        new_area = get_min_area(pts)
+        
+        # Hill climbing (accept if area increases)
+        if new_area > best_area:
+            best_area = new_area
+            best_pts = [p[:] for p in pts]
+        else:
+            # Revert move
+            pts[idx][0], pts[idx][1] = old_x, old_y
+            
+        step *= decay
+        
+    return [tuple(p) for p in best_pts]
